name: Ring of Tunnel Vision
body:
Aura moderate divination; CL 6th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears and functions as a ring of x-ray vision. However, the wearer suffers severe limitations to his field of vision, resulting in the wearer being flat-footed against all attackers. The wearer also suffers a -5 penalty to all sight-based Perception checks and ranged attacks.

This ring can be removed by casting remove curse upon it, destroying the ring in the process.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of x-ray vision

Identification DC 31
False Identification DC 21
